name: Gamecity Padel
geoNote: Nominatim pin for Game City mall (Gamecity Shopping Centre) — club operates covered courts on site
seasonNote: Covered courts — play in any weather; book online via club site
description: Gamecity Padel brings covered padel to Game City on Gaborone's Western Bypass — two doubles courts plus Botswana's first dedicated singles court. A clear recommendation when you want bookable Gaborone padel under cover rather than an open pitch, with coaching, memberships, and online court booking on the club site.
